description: Source code for a wizard in an Odoo (OpenERP) module that handles closing a project task and optionally sending a notification email to the customer.

classes.name: wizard_close
classes.description: Wizard class managing the process of closing a project task and sending notification emails.

methods.name: _check_complete
methods.description: Determines whether to proceed to close or ask for email notification based on project settings.

methods.name: _get_data
methods.description: Retrieves email and description data for the task to prepare for notification.

methods.name: _data_send
methods.description: Sends an email notification about task closure if email is provided.

methods.name: _do_close
methods.description: Performs the actual closing of the task.

methods.name: email_send
methods.description: Sends an email regarding task closure, constructing email content with task and project details.
